fact: Drawing on the Ministry's 2019 mapping of 114 programmes, whose beneficiaries are chosen by each programme's own community, means-test, categorical, geographic or self-targeting, the paper finds Eritrean social protection lacks reliable data and has fragmented, poorly coordinated monitoring with no common standards, and describes no social registry.
title: Review of social protection experiences in Sub-Saharan Africa: The case of Eritrea
publisher: International Journal of Scientific and Management Research (Gebremichael Kibreab Habtom)
